source: sars-guide:SARS PAYE-GEN-01-G05 Guide for Employers in respect of Employment Tax Incentive, Revision 17 s14 p. 9 (ETI refund; ETI Act s10)
notes: January 2027: ETI R33 000 against R25 000 employees tax, R8 000 carried. February 2027 (end of the reconciliation period): ETI R5 000, employees tax R2 000: available 13 000, used 2 000. s14 p. 9: the employer is entitled to a refund of the total ETI available at the end of each reconciliation period (August and February), and the excess is ring-fenced: refund claimable 11 000, carried forward nil.
